head_coach.name: Hong Myung-bo
head_coach.play_style_summary: A transition-based system centered around safety-first compact mid-block defending and rapid, explosive transition play. Adapts to high-altitude settings by preserving player stamina and prioritizing tactical discipline, releasing quick wide attackers once possession is recovered.

key_players.name: Son Heung-min
key_players.performance_stats: Named MLS Transfermarkt Player of the Season for 2025. Maintained an exceptionally high shot accuracy and key pass frequency, leading LAFC to success and dominating current assist tables in 2026 with elite crossing accuracy.

key_players.name: Lee Kang-in
key_players.performance_stats: Superb ball-carrying and vision. Maintained over 88% pass completion rate and 2.1 key passes per 90 minutes. Vital creative force for Paris Saint-Germain, helping them capture the UEFA Champions League title.

key_players.name: Kim Min-jae
key_players.performance_stats: Named official Player of the Match in the Champions League. Boasts a stellar 93% pass success rate, 67% long ball accuracy, 1.8 tackles, 3 recoveries, and 7 clearances per match to anchor Bayern Munich's defense.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Withdrew from the World Cup squad due to a partial tear of the plantar fascia (foot injury) sustained in a friendly against Trinidad and Tobago on May 30, 2026; replaced by Jo Wi-je.
Sidelined since September 2025 due to a torn cruciate ligament (ACL injury).
Missed squad selection after undergoing shoulder surgery in late 2025, which required a five-month recovery period.
